objective: Independent composition-aware generation of the original five core and thirteen crust targets

policy.table_matching: Diagnostic; never an unconditional pass gate
policy.physical_range: Resolve density-dependent model support before model-wide exclusion
policy.composition: Explicit species/profiles and availability masks; never fabricate missing nuclei
policy.scope: Core and crust components; no core-crust combinations or new stellar result
policy.calibration: Declared candidate calibrations remain distinct from original-author parameters

theory.result: Original 5+13 targets and source-piece boundaries identified; reusable prior comparisons preserved
Primary RMF/TF papers, HFB22/AME2016/Cu masses, Pearson analytic fits and author Fortran acquired
Species, masses, rho half-vertex, nonlinear scalar conventions, local electrons and physical branch assumptions separated
Core first law; full CLD composition/radius derivatives; TF field/envelope derivatives derived and checked
Outer pressure derived term-by-term; screened-electron elimination and complete charge response checked
Pointwise causal core boundaries and finite model assumptions separated from source-table agreement
Carreau nine/eight-nucleus and surface-area alternatives executed; source-calibration ambiguity quantified
Rest-mass-restored beta equilibrium and all-five BSk/SPG common-tangent candidate crossings constructed; original model not overwritten
BSk independent fit inconsistency measured; optional boundary-anchored pressure integration independently interval/precision checked
Generation, numerical support, source fidelity and reference differences remain separate claims; remaining scientific questions assigned

coding.result: Read current PR/base, isolated worktree; original dirty checkout preserved
Preserve baseline CI618 checksum failure and previous valid test results
Implement common five-core generator, native composition export and actual density-window handling
Implement complete spherical CLD gas-proton and neutron-drip KKT branches; 513-point/model tables
Implement all-eight finite-range RMF fields and spatial TF energy, screened electrons, geometry/radius optimization
Implement source mass-catalogue outer crust, thin-layer refinement and complete nuclear composition
Implement original BSk analytic representation and separate boundary-anchored thermodynamic variant
Retain red counterexamples and repair analytic, numerical, export and metadata defects without silently changing physical acceptance
Execute native readback, multi-start, mesh/density comparisons, independent reviews and full regression
Publish exact code/evidence identities, refreshed manifests, current model coverage and continuation commands; remote CI reported separately

claim_boundary: Execution of the two ten-step loops does not mean all original microscopic calibrations or all density domains have been established.
